name: Gross product sales
definition: Value of product lines sold: positive quantity at a positive price.
excludes: cancellations, shipping, fees, manual entries, discounts, gift vouchers, bad debt adjustments, zero-price stock movements, probable duplicates

name: Product cancellations
definition: Value of cancelled product lines (invoice numbers starting with C), booked on the cancellation date, negative by convention.

name: Net product sales
definition: Gross product sales plus product cancellations. The reference sales figure.

name: Shipping income
definition: Postage and carriage charged to customers, net of their cancellations.

name: Orders
definition: Distinct invoices with at least one product sale line.

name: Active customers
definition: Distinct identified customers with at least one product sale line.
includes: product_sale lines with a customer ID

name: Sales without a customer ID
definition: Gross product sales on lines without a customer ID. Reported, not excluded: these sales are real, but no customer KPI can use them.
includes: line_type = product_sale and customer ID missing

name: Average order value
definition: Gross product sales divided by orders.

name: Cancellation rate
definition: Product cancellations (absolute value) divided by gross product sales.
